## 2024-07-25 - WebSocket HTTP Endpoint Security Headers
**Vulnerability:** Missing security headers (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options) on HTTP endpoints served by the WebSocket library.
**Learning:** Even when primarily serving a WebSocket server, any HTTP endpoints (like `/` or `/health`) created using the same library still require explicit security headers to prevent MIME-sniffing and clickjacking attacks.
**Prevention:** Always verify that any HTTP responses (e.g. `websockets.http11.Response`) generated by a WebSocket library include necessary security headers like `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` and `X-Frame-Options: DENY`.
